No street named Victory on this part of the plate. The only N-S street meeting Chapel near the expected point is DURRELL AVE (60 ft), which ends at Chapel from the north, about 230 px east of the expected point; picked on the assumption that Victory Parkway later took over Durrell Ave. If Victory Parkway did not exist here in 1922, treat as not found.
William Howard Taft Road = LOCUST ST. on the plate. Bell Pl. runs south from Locust.

Taft Road runs along the bottom plate edge; Cleinview comes from the north and continues as a short stub south of Taft cut by the plate edge. South side of Taft is at/over the plate edge, so y is estimated from a ~76 px street width.

Y-junction at the top plate edge: Dixmont Av. branches east off Gilbert at a sharp angle; the block between them is off-plate. Point is the middle of the junction mouth, where Dixmont's centreline meets Gilbert's (streetcar track). Gilbert also meets Victory (printed VICTORY) near x 3330, y 230.

The only street meeting Fairfield near the expected point is an E-W street printed '... AVE.' (name lies west of the region) that ends at Fairfield from the west; taken as De Sales Lane. Street ~62 px (40 ft) wide.
